column2: 利慕伊勒王的言語，是他母親教訓他的真言。
column3: The words of King Lemuel, the oracle which his mother taught him:

column2: 我的兒啊，我腹中生的兒啊，我許願得的兒啊！我當怎樣教訓你呢？
column3: What, O my son? And what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?

column2: 不要將你的精力給婦女；也不要有敗壞君王的行為。
column3: Do not give your strength to women, Or your ways to that which destroys kings.

column2: 利慕伊勒啊，君王喝酒，君王喝酒不相宜；王子說濃酒在那裡也不相宜；
column3: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, It is not for kings to drink wine, Or for rulers to desire strong drink,

column2: 恐怕喝了就忘記律例，顛倒一切困苦人的是非。
column3: For they will drink and forget what is decreed, And pervert the rights of all the afflicted.

column2: 可以把濃酒給將亡的人喝，把清酒給苦心的人喝，
column3: Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to him whose life is bitter.

column2: 讓他喝了，就忘記他的貧窮，不再記念他的苦楚。
column3: Let him drink and forget his poverty And remember his trouble no more.

column2: 你當為啞巴（或譯：不能自辯的）開口，為一切孤獨的伸冤。
column3: Open your mouth for the mute, For the rights of all the unfortunate.

column2: 你當開口按公義判斷，為困苦和窮乏的辨屈。
column3: Open your mouth, judge righteously, And defend the rights of the afflicted and needy.

column2: 才德的婦人誰能得著呢？他的價值遠勝過珍珠。
column3: An excellent wife, who can find? For her worth is far above jewels.

column2: 他丈夫心裡倚靠他，必不缺少利益.；
column3: The heart of her husband trusts in her, And he will have no lack of gain.

column2: 他一生使丈夫有益無損。
column3: She does him good and not evil All the days of her life.

column2: 他尋找羊羢和麻，甘心用手做工。
column3: She looks for wool and flax And works with her hands in delight.

column2: 他好像商船從遠方運糧來，
column3: She is like merchant ships; She brings her food from afar.

column2: 未到黎明他就起來，把食物分給家中的人，將當做的工分派婢女。
column3: She rises also while it is still night And gives food to her household And portions to her maidens.

column2: 他想得田地就買來；用手所得之利栽種葡萄園。
column3: She considers a field and buys it; From her earnings she plants a vineyard.

column2: 他以能力束腰，使膀臂有力。
column3: She girds herself with strength And makes her arms strong.

column2: 他覺得所經營的有利；他的燈終夜不滅
column3: She senses that her gain is good; Her lamp does not go out at night.

column2: 他手拿撚線竿，手把紡線車。
column3: She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hands grasp the spindle.

column2: 他張手賙濟困苦人，伸手幫補窮乏人。
column3: She extends her hand to the poor, And she stretches out her hands to the needy.

column2: 他不因下雪為家裡的人擔心，因為全家都穿著朱紅衣服。
column3: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, For all her household are clothed with scarlet.

column2: 他為自己製作繡花毯子；他的衣服是細麻和紫色布作的。
column3: She makes coverings for herself; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

column2: 他丈夫在城門口與本地的長老同坐，為眾人所認識。
column3: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land.

column2: 他做細麻布衣裳出賣，又將腰帶賣與商家。
column3: She makes linen garments and sells [them], And supplies belts to the tradesmen.

column2: 能力和威儀是他的衣服；他想到日後的景況就喜笑。
column3: Strength and dignity are her clothing, And she smiles at the future.

column2: 他開口就發智慧；他舌上有仁慈的法則。
column3: She opens her mouth in wisdom, And the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.

column2: 他觀察家務，並不吃閒飯。
column3: She looks well to the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.

column2: 他的兒女起來，稱他有福；他的丈夫也稱讚他，
column3: Her children rise up and bless her; Her husband [also], and he praises her, [saying]:

column2: 說：才德的女子很多，惟獨你超過一切。
column3: 'Many daughters have done nobly, But you excel them all.'

column2: 艷麗是虛假的，美容是虛浮的；惟敬畏耶和華的婦女必得稱讚。
column3: Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain, [But] a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

column2: 願他享受操作所得的；願他的工作在城門口榮耀他。
column3: Give her the product of her hands, And let her works praise her in the gates.
